problem_statement: codrops/Interactive3DMallMap ships a static Codrops "Interactive 3D Mall Map": a fixed full-viewport 3D map of a four-level shopping mall with pin indicators, a search box and an A - Z sortable directory of 31 real spaces (Apple Heart, Smoothies & Soul, Rocketship Tech, Breathe, Hot Tub Festival, Meditation Garden and more) that are already organised into four store categories (Nourish & Refresh, Learn & Create, Swap & Give, Rest & Recharge), plus a shared cross-page chrome layer (a shared masthead nav and footer) and a Mall visit planner page. The map has category coloring and A - Z sort but no way to FILTER the directory by category. Add a native Wayfinding filter HUD: a category-filter toolbar rendered as a normal-flow band directly under the shared masthead and above the fixed 3D map, on BOTH the Mall map home (index.html) and the Mall visit planner page (planner.html). The toolbar shows five filter chips (All, Nourish & Refresh, Learn & Create, Swap & Give, Rest & Recharge) and a live count readout '#directory-readout' that reads 'Showing 31 of 31 spaces - All categories' initially. Clicking a category chip must filter the directory list and map pins to that category, mark the chip active, and RECOMPUTE the readout from the live filtered set (e.g. clicking Learn & Create yields 'Showing 7 of 31 spaces - Learn & Create'). The toolbar chips must wrap and stay legible so the page is free of horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile, the chips must remain a tidy legible pill row (not oversized overlapping dark-on-dark slabs that bury the map), and the same Wayfinding filter toolbar must appear consistently on the Mall map home AND the Mall visit planner page. Preserve the existing interactive mall map (fixed 3D map, pins, search, A - Z sortable directory and Codrops frame).
required_content: Add a native Wayfinding filter HUD toolbar above the 3D map with five category chips (All, Nourish & Refresh, Learn & Create, Swap & Give, Rest & Recharge) and a live count readout.

Wire each chip so clicking it filters the A - Z directory list and dims the non-matching map pins, marks the clicked chip active, and recomputes the readout from the live filtered set (clicking Learn & Create yields 'Showing 7 of 31 spaces - Learn & Create').
Render the same Wayfinding filter toolbar consistently on BOTH the Mall map home (index.html) and the Mall visit planner page (planner.html), not only on the home page.
Keep the toolbar chips wrapping and legible so the Mall map home and the Mall visit planner page have no horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile.
Preserve the interactive mall map (fixed 3D map, pin indicators, search, A - Z sortable directory and Codrops frame) and the grounded planner stops.
design_constraints: The Wayfinding filter chips must be a tidy, legible, wrapping pill row with rounded pill corners, adequate light-on-dark text contrast, consistent chip spacing and the map's teal accent on the active chip; do not render oversized overlapping dark-on-dark slabs with negative margins that shingle, collide and bury the 3D map.
The category-count readout must be recomputed live from the filtered directory on every chip click, never a frozen 'Showing 31 of 31 spaces - All categories' snapshot.
The Wayfinding filter toolbar must render consistently on both the Mall map home and the Mall visit planner page.
Keep the toolbar and directory free of horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile.
Do not remove or replace the interactive mall map, pins, search, directory or Codrops frame.
state_constraints: desktop_filter_all verifies the Wayfinding filter toolbar renders on the Mall map home with five category chips and the readout 'Showing 31 of 31 spaces - All categories'.
desktop_filter_learn verifies that clicking the Learn & Create chip recomputes the readout to 'Showing 7 of 31 spaces - Learn & Create' (the filter is wired, not a frozen snapshot).
mobile_filter_home and mobile_home verify the toolbar wraps and stays free of horizontal overflow at 390px.
desktop_planner and mobile_planner verify the Wayfinding filter toolbar also renders on the Mall visit planner page so the control is consistent across pages.

change_completion: A Wayfinding filter toolbar with five category chips and a live count readout is added above the 3D map.
Clicking a category chip filters the directory and recomputes the readout from the live filtered set.
design_consistency: The Wayfinding filter toolbar renders consistently on both the Mall map home and the Mall visit planner page.
The filter chips are a tidy legible wrapping pill row consistent with the map's category coloring, not oversized overlapping slabs.
regression: The interactive mall map, pins, search, A - Z sortable directory and Codrops frame remain intact.
No existing section is removed and the planner stops remain grounded in real levels and directory spaces.
responsive: The toolbar chips wrap and the Mall map home and Mall visit planner page have no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile.
The chips and readout stay legible on mobile and tablet.

author_notes: Add a native Wayfinding filter HUD to the codrops Interactive 3D Mall Map: a category-filter toolbar over the mall directory, rendered as a normal-flow band above the fixed 3D map on both the Mall map home and the Mall visit planner page. The map already colors its 31 directory spaces by four categories (Nourish & Refresh, Learn & Create, Swap & Give, Rest & Recharge) and ships list.js, so a category filter is the map's own natural on-map control. The reference renders a tidy wrapping pill chip row plus a live count readout ('#directory-readout') that recomputes from the filtered directory on every click, filters the A - Z list and dims non-matching pins, and appears on index.html AND planner.html. INFRA (identical across reference, baseline and bad, NOT part of the task content): the shared masthead nav / footer (nav-links.js + site-nav.js), css/site-shared.css, the planner card grid and the Codrops mall map already serve fully offline (local favicon, css and js, no analytics). The leg-varying files are index.html, planner.html, css/wayfinding.css and js/wayfinding.js. The BASELINE has the original responsive layout defect: the chips are fixed-width and never wrap, so at 390px mobile the toolbar overflows the page horizontally, and it never renders the toolbar on the Mall visit planner page (only on the home) - but its filter wiring is correct so the readout does recompute. The BAD solution is a smart-looking restyle that is genuinely broken: the chips become oversized dark slate slabs with negative margins that shingle and overlap into a collided illegible dark-on-dark stack that spills over and buries the top of the 3D map and overflows the page, its filter click still lights the chip and re-filters the directory but the count readout is snapshotted once at init and stays frozen on 'Showing 31 of 31 spaces - All categories' so the wayfinding count is wrong for every category, and its off-system HUD is wired only into the Mall map home and never rendered on the Mall visit planner page, so the control is not consistent across pages.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Ledger-aligned codrops Interactive 3D Mall Map static wayfinding concept (index.html + js/main.js + css/style.css + list.js, no build): a fixed four-level 3D mall map with pins, search and an A - Z sortable directory of 31 real spaces already organised into four store categories. The map's own missing native control is a category filter over that directory, so an interactive_canvas Consistency task can ADD a Wayfinding filter HUD (a category-chip toolbar + live count readout) as an on-map control panel that must filter the directory, recompute its count live, stay legible and overflow-free at mobile, and render consistently on the Mall map home and the Mall visit planner page - without burying the 3D map or freezing the count.
